prompts.03: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create an original editorial photograph for an Instagram carousel about parents listening to children's ideas for games. Fictional Brazilian mother, around 38 years old, medium brown skin, softly curly dark brown hair tied in a loose bun, wearing an ivory cotton short-sleeved blouse and blue jeans. Her fictional daughter, around 11 years old, light-medium brown skin, straight dark shoulder-length hair and a cornflower blue T-shirt, sitting on a neutral beige sofa in their modest warm contemporary living room. A laptop on low oak coffee table, ONLY BACK OF LID visible, screen faces the girl and away from camera. Mother sits naturally on the sturdy wide arm of the sofa at girl's left, slightly leaning in, asking her something with an interested friendly expression and an open palm. Girl has taken her eyes off the laptop, turns fully toward mother, thoughtful and interested as she starts answering. Eye contact between them, mother listens without taking over, no phone. Blue, cream and small yellow cushion accents. Natural window daylight, believable home, no exaggerated stock-photo gestures. No visible software, no legible text, no logos, no watermark. All limbs correct, normal proportions. These are fictional people, do not emulate any real person.
